items.title_zh: Anthropic IPO估值或取决于2028年2000亿美元营收目标

items.summary_en: Anthropic IPO valuation rests on up to $200 billion 2028 revenue target - Reuters Investing.com
items.why_zh: 该消息揭示了AI公司高估值与未来营收目标之间的紧密关联，对理解AI产业资本动态有重要意义。
items.why_en: This highlights how AI startup valuations are tied to aggressive future revenue projections, offering insight into the AI investment landscape.

items.title_zh: 大语言模型时代的AI问责生态系统
items.title_en: The AI Accountability Ecosystem in the Era of Language Models
items.summary_zh: 一篇发表于arXiv的论文回顾并更新了AI问责生态系统框架。研究认为，大语言模型向公众开放后，AI治理格局发生深刻变化，原有问责框架需要同步演进。作者提出三项相互关联的更新：一是将问责对象扩展至AI基础设施与供应链；二是强化结果监测和问题识别，为去中心化的系统改进提供支撑；三是补充其他调整，以完善整体框架。这些建议旨在帮助监管者、开发者和研究者在语言模型时代更好地落实AI问责。该研究为AI治理政策提供了新的理论视角和操作方向。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.12320v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: This article reviews and updates the framework for accountability in AI based on account- ability ecosystems. We update the framework in light of the latest developments since the release of Large Language Models for general public use. We propose three interlinked updates to the original AI accountability ecosystem: (i) reorienting the accountability ecosystem to AI infrastructure and supply chains, (ii) providing greater emphasis on outcomes monitoring and identification of issues that support decentralized system improvement, and (iii) incor…
items.why_zh: 该研究为语言模型时代如何构建AI问责体系提供了系统性的框架更新，对AI治理与政策设计有直接启示。
items.why_en: This study offers a timely update to AI accountability frameworks, directly informing governance and policy in the era of large language models.

items.title_zh: 语言模型生成的小说表现出压缩的形式变化
items.title_en: Novels generated by language models show compressed formal variation
items.summary_zh: 一项针对AI生成小说的新研究表明，大语言模型虽然能够创作完整小说，但多次生成后的形式多样性可能低于人类创作。该研究没有聚焦于单段文字是否由AI生成，而是比较了不同来源和风格的多组语料库，其中包括使用GPT-5.5 Thinking生成的20部19世纪英国现实主义风格小说。通过对比AI生成文本与人类语料库，研究者发现AI文本在风格和结构上可能存在“压缩”现象，即形式变化范围较窄。这一发现对理解AI创作的本质及其与人类文学的差异具有重要意义，也为AI辅助写作的多样性提出了新课题。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.12630v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: While large language models can generate entire novels, there is little information about the level of formal variation in their output over many generations. Rather than asking whether individual passages can be identified as AI-generated, this study asks whether repeated AI generation can produce the same range of diversity which is found across human corpora. This paper contrasts six corpora based on generation source and target style: twenty novels generated using GPT-5.5 Thinking in a nineteenth-century British realist style, twenty novels…
items.why_zh: 该研究从形式多样性角度揭示了AI生成文学与人类创作的差异，对评估AI创意能力具有参考价值。
items.why_en: The study sheds light on formal diversity gaps between AI-generated and human literature, informing assessments of AI's creative capabilities.

items.title_zh: Mimir v1：1B参数开放模型以合规数据实现前沿性能
items.title_en: DFM Mimir v1: An Open HRM Delivering Frontier Performance at 1B Parameters Using Only Permissible Post-Training Data
items.summary_zh: 一项新研究推出了Mimir v1，这是一个仅有10亿参数的语言模型，采用分层推理模型（HRM）架构，并从零开始训练。该模型的核心特点是仅使用允许使用的后训练数据，即符合版权和伦理要求的数据集，避免了大模型开发中常见的海量非许可数据。Mimir v1在英语任务上表现极具竞争力，并在丹麦语上创下了新纪录。研究团队利用161个数据集的混合数据完成训练，展示了在合规前提下实现高性能的可能性。这一成果有望降低开源模型在数据和法律层面的门槛，推动负责任的AI发展。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.13517v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Current large language model development relies on massive, often non-permissible datasets, creating a high barrier for researchers committed to open-source and ethically sourced data. We introduce Mimir v1, a 1-billion-parameter language model based on the Hierarchical Reasoning Model (HRM) architecture, that is trained from scratch and delivers highly competitive performance for English and sets a new state of the art for Danish using only permissible post-training data. Trained on a mixture of 161 datasets, Mimir v1 outperforms the original…
items.why_zh: 该模型证明仅凭许可数据也能训练出高性能语言模型，为开源AI的合规化发展开辟了新路径。
items.why_en: Mimir v1 shows that frontier performance is achievable with permissible data, offering a path for ethical and open AI development.

items.title_zh: LittleLearner：在可控知识暴露下训练语言模型
items.title_en: LittleLearner: Language Models Under Pedagogically Controlled Knowledge Exposure
items.summary_zh: 一项研究推出LittleLearner模型，旨在通过控制训练数据的知识范围来研究语言模型的知识获取过程。研究人员构建了名为LITTLECURRICULUM的预训练语料库，包含880亿个token，内容限定为美国小学阶段材料，并明确排除了五年级以上教授的概念、事实和词汇。他们使用该语料库从零训练了一个50亿参数的模型LittleLearner。结果显示，该模型具备足够的语言能力，可用于探究模型如何从特定教学环境中习得知识与技能。这一方法为理解大模型知识来源提供了一种可控的实验途径，也有助于评估课程设计对模型能力的影响。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.13545v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Modern language models are trained on heterogeneous web-scale text corpora. Consequently, studying knowledge and skill acquisition is difficult, as prior exposure to related content is hard to characterize. To address this challenge, we introduce LITTLECURRICULUM, a curated 88B-token pretraining corpus tailored to U.S. elementary school material, explicitly excluding concepts, facts, and vocabulary taught above Grade 5. Training a 5B-parameter LLM from scratch on LITTLECURRICULUM yields LITTLELEARNER, a model with sufficient language competence…
items.why_zh: 通过教学级语料库控制知识暴露，该研究为揭示大模型知识获取机制提供了新颖的实验范式。
items.why_en: This controlled training approach offers a new experimental paradigm for understanding how language models acquire knowledge.

items.title_zh: spotforecast2-safe：面向安全关键环境的欧盟AI法案合规开源预测包
items.title_en: Time-Series Forecasting in Safety-Critical Environments: An Open-Source Package for EU-AI-Act-Compliant Development / Zeitreihenprognose in sicherheitskritischen Umgebungen: Ein Open-Source-Paket f\"ur die KI-VO-konforme Entwicklung
items.summary_zh: 一项研究发布了spotforecast2-safe，这是一个为安全关键环境设计的时间序列点预测开源Python包。与现有合规工具通常作为外部扫描器、模板或运行时层不同，该工具采用合规性设计理念，将欧盟《人工智能法案》（EU AI Act / KI-VO）、IEC 61508以及ISA/IEC 62443等标准的要求直接嵌入库内部。这使得开发者在构建预测应用时能更自然地满足安全与合规要求，而不必依赖外部附加层。该工具旨在支持安全关键领域的时间序列预测需求，其“合规即设计”思路为AI工程实践提供了新参考。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2604.23859v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: With spotforecast2-safe we present an integrated Compliance-by-Design approach to Python-based point forecasting of time series in safety-critical environments. A review of the relevant open-source tooling shows that existing compliance solutions operate consistently outside of the library to be used - e.g. as scanners, templates, or runtime layers. spotforecast2-safe takes the inverse approach and anchors the requirements of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 (the EU AI Act, in German: KI-VO), of IEC 61508, of the ISA/IEC 62443 standards series, and…
items.why_zh: 它展示了如何将欧盟AI法案等复杂监管要求内置于开发工具中，对工业AI落地具有重要意义。
items.why_en: This package demonstrates how to embed EU AI Act compliance directly into development tools, a crucial step for industrial AI adoption.

items.title_zh: 面向AI时代的营养数据基础设施：为智能体中介研究实现FAIR可操作性
items.title_en: Nutrition Data Infrastructure for the AI Era: Operationalizing FAIR for Agent-Mediated Research
items.summary_zh: 本文介绍营养数据服务（NDS），这是一种保留来源的基础设施，旨在让AI智能体能够可靠地加速营养研究。由于AI分析会继承底层数据的身份、语义和发布歧义，NDS通过描述解析、类型化交叉映射和机器可读接口，使特定发布记录可被发现、不同来源资源可相互连接，并支持可回放和可审计的分析。在食品描述基准测试中，NDS表现出优于现有方法的性能。该工作为营养科学数据的自动复用和可验证研究提供了新基础设施。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.10363v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: AI agents can accelerate nutrition research, but their analyses inherit the identity, semantic, and release ambiguities of the underlying data. We present Nutrition Data Service (NDS), source-preserving infrastructure that operationalizes FAIR for automated use: description resolution makes release-specific records findable; typed crosswalks connect independently released resources; machine-readable interfaces expose versioned sources and crosswalks, supporting replayable and auditable analyses. On food-description benchmarks, NDS outperforms…
items.why_zh: 它为AI驱动的营养研究提供了标准化、可审计的数据基础设施，解决了数据歧义这一关键瓶颈。
items.why_en: It addresses a key bottleneck in AI-driven nutrition research by providing standardized, auditable data infrastructure.

items.title_zh: OEIS Open：语言模型能把多少猜想变成定理？
items.title_en: OEIS Open: How many conjectures can language models turn into theorems?
items.summary_zh: 本文构建了OEIS Open基准，包含来自OEIS的492个开放数学猜想，并已由Tsoukalas等人用Lean形式化。此前这些猜想仅由专用智能体尝试，现在研究团队提供了开源评估代码，可运行任意通用语言模型，并防止模型作弊。实验显示，配备最小工具集的语言模型在每次尝试50美元预算下能解决其中147个猜想，在OEIS Open上得分30%。此外还提供了包含100个猜想的OEIS Open Lite子集，以便更轻量地评估模型能力。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.11941v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We construct OEIS Open, a benchmark based on 492 open mathematical conjectures from the OEIS, formalized in Lean by Tsoukalas et al. Whereas these conjectures had previously been attempted only with a bespoke agent, our open-source evaluation code runs any generic language model (LM) against them, and is secure against LM cheating attempts. We find that LMs equipped with a minimal set of tools resolve 147 of these conjectures with a budget of \$50 per attempt, scoring 30% on OEIS Open. OEIS Open Lite is a random subset of 100 conjectures for…
items.why_zh: 它首次允许通用语言模型在统一、防作弊的基准上挑战开放数学猜想，拓宽了AI数学研究评估的边界。
items.why_en: This benchmark enables generic LMs to tackle open math conjectures on a unified, cheat-resistant platform, advancing evaluation of AI mathematical reasoning.

items.title_zh: 大规模反学习：十亿参数语言模型中的状态精确、痕迹保留删除
items.title_en: Unlearning at Scale: State-Exact Trace-Preserving Deletion in Billion-Parameter Language Models
items.summary_zh: 本文研究大语言模型的精确反学习问题：在指定样本离开重放数据集后，能否通过前瞻性仪器化的训练续跑精确重现“删除反事实”？作者提出一种保留痕迹的反事实方法，固定记录的执行控制，同时将被请求标识符的贡献设为零。该保证是前瞻性的，原始运行需记录执行来源并保留未受污染的检查点。在固定的单GPU环境中，从不含被删除行的令牌存储重放，可以重建删除后的模型状态。这为十亿参数模型提供了一种精确删除训练数据影响的可行机制。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2508.12220v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Can a prospectively instrumented training continuation reproduce a deletion counterfactual exactly after selected examples leave its replay dataset? We study a trace-preserving counterfactual that fixes recorded execution controls while assigning requested identifiers zero contribution. The guarantee is prospective: the original run must record this execution provenance and retain an eligible uncontaminated checkpoint. Under pinned single-GPU environments, replay from a token store materialized without the requested rows reconstructs a…
items.why_zh: 它为十亿参数模型提供了一种精确删除训练数据影响的可行机制，对隐私和数据权利至关重要。
items.why_en: It demonstrates a viable mechanism for exact data deletion in billion-parameter models, crucial for privacy and data rights.

items.title_zh: MOSAIC：揭示大语言模型的道德、社会与个体维度
items.title_en: MOSAIC: Unveiling the Moral, Social and Individual Dimensions of Large Language Models
items.summary_zh: 大语言模型越来越多地部署在心理咨询、医疗和高风险决策等敏感应用中，这引发了对它们伦理推理可靠性的关键质疑。然而，现有研究和基准几乎完全依赖道德基础理论，忽视了社会价值观、人格特质和个人维度等其他重要方面。为此，本文提出MOSAIC，旨在系统性地揭示LLM在这些被忽略维度上的表现。这一框架有望为评估和改进大语言模型的伦理推理提供更全面的视角。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2603.00048v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in sensitive applications including psychological support, healthcare, and high-stakes decision-making. This expansion has motivated growing research into the ethical and moral foundations underlying LLM behavior, raising critical questions about their reliability in ethical reasoning. However, existing studies and benchmarks rely almost exclusively on Moral Foundation Theory (MFT), largely neglecting other relevant dimensions such as social values, personality traits, and individua…
items.why_zh: 它打破了仅依赖道德基础理论评估LLM伦理的局限，为全面理解AI行为提供了多维框架。
items.why_en: It moves beyond the narrow reliance on Moral Foundation Theory, offering a more comprehensive framework for understanding LLM ethical behavior.

items.title_zh: 多臂贝叶斯老虎机中的退火Softmax贪心算法
items.title_en: Annealed Softmax Greedy in Many-Armed Bayesian Bandits
items.summary_zh: 在可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）和GRPO等基于组的策略优化方法中，策略更新通过采样多个完成并为高奖励完成增加概率来实现，同时用KL惩罚向参考策略正则化，但这些更新不包含显式跟踪认知不确定性的机制。本文通过分析多臂贝叶斯老虎机中的退火Softmax（玻尔兹曼）贪心算法，为这种不感知不确定性的更新为何仍然有效提供了一个简化的解释。该研究有助于理解RLVR和GRPO类方法在实践中成功的原因。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2605.31034v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) and group-based policy optimization methods such as GRPO update a stochastic policy by sampling multiple completions per prompt and increasing the policy's probability on those with higher reward, regularized by a KL penalty toward a reference policy. These updates do not include explicit mechanisms that track epistemic uncertainty. This paper studies a stylized explanation for why such uncertainty-agnostic updates can nevertheless be effective. We analyze an annealed softmax (Boltzm…
items.why_zh: 它为不确定性无关的更新为何在RLVR/GRPO中有效提供了理论解释，有助于设计更可靠的策略优化方法。
items.why_en: It offers a theoretical explanation for the effectiveness of uncertainty-agnostic updates in RLVR/GRPO, guiding more reliable policy optimization.

items.title_zh: 基于XAI的数据缩减实现时间序列分类的规模化
items.title_en: Scaling Time Series Classification via XAI-Driven Data Reduction
items.summary_zh: 虽然时间序列可解释人工智能（XAI）算法发展迅速，但其在下游任务中带来可衡量性能提升的效用仍未充分探索。本文提出drXAI方法，将XAI归因方法重新用于时间序列分类（TSC）的高效数据缩减。现代TSC的核心挑战是可扩展性，像Transformer等最先进模型在序列长度上具有二次复杂度，数据规模成为瓶颈。drXAI通过XAI指导的数据缩减来降低这种负担，从而提升可扩展性。这项工作展示了XAI在优化模型性能方面的新用途。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2607.15774v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Explainable AI (XAI) for time series has seen significant algorithmic growth, but its utility in providing measurable performance gains for downstream tasks remains under-explored. This paper bridges this gap by introducing drXAI, a novel methodology that repurposes XAI attribution methods for effective data reduction in Time Series Classification (TSC). The core challenge in modern TSC is scalability; state-of-the-art models, such as Transformers, exhibit quadratic complexity relative to sequence length and linear complexity relative t…
items.why_zh: 它展示了XAI不仅能解释模型，还能通过数据缩减直接提升时间序列分类的可扩展性。
items.why_en: It shows XAI can directly improve scalability in time series classification via data reduction, expanding its practical utility.

items.title_zh: TCS-Bench：评估生成式AI在理论计算机科学研究中的能力
items.title_en: TCS-BENCH: Benchmarking State-of-the-Art Generative AI Theoretical Computer Science Research Ability
items.summary_zh: 本文提出TCS-Bench，一个用于评估大语言模型在科研级理论计算机科学（TCS）证明生成能力的基准。该基准包含来自STOC、FOCS和SODA等顶级理论计算机科学会议论文中的定理证明任务，每项任务都提供了推导目标结果自包含证明所需的必要上下文。研究团队评估了最先进的模型，并使用验证智能体验证生成证明的正确性，还进一步对验证器自身进行了基准测试。这为衡量生成式AI在理论计算机科学领域的科研能力提供了标准化工具。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.09538v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We introduce TCS-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating Large Language Models (LLMs) on research-level Theoretical Computer Science (TCS) proof generation. TCS-Bench consists of theorem-proving tasks from papers published at top theoretical computer science venues (STOC, FOCS, and SODA). Each task provides the necessary context to derive a self-contained proof for a target result. We evaluate state-of-the-art models on this benchmark. We verify the correctness of generated proofs via a verification agent, and further benchmark the verifier a…
items.why_zh: 它为量化生成式AI在理论计算机科学科研级任务上的能力提供了首个标准化基准。
items.why_en: It provides a standardized benchmark for measuring generative AI's research-level capability in theoretical computer science.

items.summary_zh: 智谱发布GLM-5.3：开源的“安全之盾”|AutoClaw|WorkBuddy|CodeBuddy|Qoder|开源模型_手机新浪网 新浪网

items.why_en: As a major Chinese AI company, Zhipu's open-source model update with a safety focus may shape the open-source LLM ecosystem.

items.title_en: ECARX: Flyme Auto System Installed in 135,201 Vehicles in July, Cumulative Installations Exceed 3.28 Million
items.summary_zh: IT之家 8 月 15 日消息，亿咖通科技昨晚宣布， Flyme Auto 系统 7 月装机 135,201 辆 。 据介绍，Flyme Auto 系统 1-7 月装机量超 101.8 万。截至目前，产品累计装机量超 328.5 万。 据IT之家此前报道， 魅族 Flyme Auto 车载软件系统发布于 2023 年 3 月 ，支持无缝接力、手机辅助 OTA、手机-汽车硬件互通共享硬件能力，支持手机寻车，支持平行视窗、小窗展示、跨端可见即可说等软件功能。 Flyme Auto 2 发布于去年 8 月 ，带来了实况桌面 3D 质感、全场景一镜到底、Alive 壁纸、自定义桌面插件等功能，Aicy 大卡片、全新小窗模式提供了更轻量更高效的交互方式。AI 能力贯通整车全域，AI 读心术主动判断用户意图，自动完成常用操作，并且此次更新还提供了更全面的应用生态和互联生态。
items.summary_en: ECARX announced that its Flyme Auto in-car system was installed in 135,201 vehicles in July, bringing the cumulative installations to over 3.28 million. The system, launched in March 2023, supports seamless connectivity and hardware sharing between phones and cars. The Flyme Auto 2 upgrade, released last August, adds 3D live wallpapers, AI-driven intent detection, and a broader app ecosystem.
items.why_zh: 这一装机量数据表明Flyme Auto在智能座舱市场快速放量，是国产车载AI系统规模落地的重要信号。
items.why_en: The installation figures show rapid adoption of Flyme Auto in the smart cockpit market, marking a significant milestone for domestic in-car AI systems.

items.title_en: Honor YOYO Claw integrates Zhipu GLM-5.3, boosting coding ability by 50%
items.summary_zh: IT之家 8 月 15 日消息，荣耀全场景软件主理人 @荣耀席迎军 昨晚宣布， 荣耀 YOYO Claw 正式接入智谱最新发布的 GLM-5.3 大模型 ，“虾虾大脑”全新升级。 通过更大规模、更长周期、更多样任务环境的后训练，GLM-5.3 进一步释放模型能力上限：编程能力较上一代提升 50%，并在多项公开基准测试中取得开源模型第一；在代码审查、漏洞发现等网络安全任务中，能力也进一步提升，表现更加优秀。 据IT之家此前报道，在今年 4 月的荣耀 PC 新品技术沟通会上， 荣耀版“龙虾”YOYO Claw 发布 。官方在现场进行了多个场景演示，包括媒体运营助虾、3D 打印虾等。 另外，YOYO Claw 于 3 月 27 日开启封测，支持跨端执行任务，也可以选择“荣耀虾”进行养殖，包括荣耀 PC、荣耀 Pad 设备。此外，YOYO Claw 也能连接第三方龙虾，包括其他设备上的 OpenClaw。 作为参考， 智谱昨日正式发布 GLM-5.3 ，与 GLM-5.2 相比，基座模型没变，但通过后训练 Scaling 大大提高了模型的智能上界：数十倍的长程任务环境、更丰富多样的环境类型、超长的后训练时间。 相比前代，GLM-5.3 的新能力包括： 更强的编程能力。GLM-5.3 是编程能力最强的开源模型，在内部自建体感评测中较 GLM-5.2 提升 50%，在包括 Terminal B…
items.summary_en: Honor has integrated Zhipu's latest GLM-5.3 model into its YOYO Claw AI agent. GLM-5.3 features a 50% improvement in coding ability over its predecessor and top-ranked open-source performance in several benchmarks, along with enhanced cybersecurity capabilities. The upgraded agent supports cross-device tasks and connections to third-party OpenClaw, enabling more complex automation.

items.title_zh: 美团：无锡、上海、杭州等城市评估“红灯停表”功能，预计今年内覆盖超百万骑手
items.title_en: Meituan's 'Red Light Stop Watch' trial expands, targeting 1M+ riders by year-end
items.summary_zh: IT之家 8 月 15 日消息，8 月 13 日，美团骑手“红灯停表”功能在北京正式试点上线。当路遇红灯时，等待的时间将自动计入后台，并为骑手相应顺延配送时间。目前，试点已在北京朝阳区、通州区、经济技术开发区部分率先接入交通数据的道路上展开。 美团官方透露，目前， 无锡、上海、杭州、成都、南昌、兰州 等 20 余个城市也在评估中，具备条件的城市将陆续上线，预计今年内覆盖超百万骑手。接下来，美团也会同步推动 用户端的实时信息展示 ，争取让用户未来也能看到骑手的实时配送情况，减少焦虑。 据IT之家今年 7 月报道，美团和苏州公安率先联合上线了 外卖骑手“等灯停表”功能首个正式版本 ，已在率先接入交通数据的苏州道路进行实际路测。 当骑手在交通路口等红灯时，页面呈现红灯倒计时读秒信息，美团骑手 AI 安全助手发布提示信息“红灯停一停，正在记录等灯时长， 订单结束时将延长本单配送时间 ”，骑手还可在该页面中看到所在区域的禁行道路信息，选择不同的配送路线，或根据需求自主决定配送线路。 配送完成后，骑手页面弹窗提示“订单号、等红灯累计时间”，系统告知“相应顺延最晚送达时间”，完成“等灯停表”功能。
items.summary_en: Meituan launched a pilot of its "Red Light Stop Watch" feature for food delivery riders in Beijing on August 13. The feature automatically counts waiting time at red lights and extends delivery deadlines accordingly. The company plans to roll it out to more than 20 cities and cover over one million riders this year, while also improving real-time updates for users.
items.why_zh: 通过技术手段将等红灯时间纳入配送时长，既减轻骑手压力，也为行业提供了更人性化的配送管理方案。
items.why_en: By crediting red-light waiting time to riders' delivery schedules, Meituan alleviates rider pressure and sets a new standard for humane delivery management.

items.title_zh: Anthropic最新AI风险报告披露未发布Model 2细节及新的对齐问题
items.title_en: Anthropic details unreleased Model 2, new alignment concerns in latest AI risk report
items.summary_zh: Anthropic在其最新的AI风险报告中，详细介绍了尚未发布的Model 2模型，并提出了新的AI对齐问题。该报告可能涵盖模型的潜在能力、可能被滥用的场景以及现有的防护措施。作为一家以AI安全为核心使命的企业，Anthropic选择在模型正式发布前公开这些信息，显示其希望在研发阶段就引发关于先进AI风险的讨论。新的对齐担忧或涉及模型在复杂任务中与人类意图一致性方面的挑战。此份报告不仅对Anthropic自身重要，也可能影响行业对高风险AI系统的透明度与监管要求。

items.why_zh: Anthropic提前公开未发布模型的安全细节，为建设性的AI风险讨论树立了标杆。
items.why_en: Anthropic's disclosure of safety details for an upcoming model sets a benchmark for proactive AI risk discussion.

items.title_zh: Anthropic季度营收突破115亿美元，筹备IPO在即
items.title_en: Anthropic quarterly revenue eclipses $11.5 billion amid IPO prep - Bloomberg
items.summary_zh: 据彭博社报道，人工智能公司Anthropic的季度营收已突破115亿美元，显示出强劲的增长势头。该公司正积极筹备首次公开募股（IPO），此举被解读为其资本战略的重要一步。这一数字反映出Anthropic在生成式AI领域的产品需求强劲，尤其受益于Claude系列模型的商用化普及。营收的快速增长也加剧了与OpenAI等竞争对手的较量。若IPO成功，Anthropic将获得更多资金用于模型研发和算力建设，同时需接受更严格的市场监督。
items.summary_en: Anthropic quarterly revenue eclipses $11.5 billion amid IPO prep - Bloomberg Investing.com
items.why_zh: Anthropic营收破百亿并冲刺IPO，标志着AI头部公司商业化进入新高度，影响资本市场和产业竞争。
items.why_en: Anthropic's blockbuster revenue and IPO push signal a new era of AI commercialization, with major implications for capital markets and industry rivalry.

items.why_zh: 中国创业公司推出对标世界顶尖模型的产品，展现中国AI研发实力，加剧国际竞争。
items.why_en: A Chinese startup challenging top-tier AI models highlights China's technological rise and intensifies global AI rivalry.

items.title_zh: OpenAI营收飙升，IPO前突破400亿美元

items.title_en: Insilico Medicine Introduces Biological Age into Virtual Cell Research: Launches Virtual Aging Cell Webpage and Previews Multi-Agent Driven VAC Generation Platform
items.summary_zh: Insilico Medicine宣布在其虚拟细胞研究中引入生物学年龄概念，并正式上线虚拟衰老细胞网页，同时预告了一个由多智能体驱动的虚拟衰老细胞（VAC）生成平台。该平台旨在利用AI模拟细胞衰老过程，为抗衰老研究和药物开发提供数字化工具。通过整合生物学年龄数据，研究人员可以更精准地预测细胞状态并筛选潜在干预方法。这一创新有望加速衰老相关疾病的药物发现，并推动计算生物学与AI的深度融合。
items.summary_en: Insilico Medicine Introduces Biological Age into Virtual Cell Research: Launches Virtual Aging Cell Webpage and Previews Multi-Agent Driven VAC Generation Platform Insilico Medicine
items.why_zh: 该平台将AI与衰老研究结合，可能为抗衰老药物开发提供全新范式，意义深远。
items.why_en: This AI-powered virtual aging cell platform could transform senescence research and anti-aging drug discovery.

items.title_zh: 扎克伯格的新“Instagzam”：Instagram换标引发困惑
items.title_en: Mark Zuckerberg has an Instagzam
items.summary_zh: 本周，Instagram推出了新的标识，但设计引发广泛困惑，许多人认为其不再像原来的Instagram标志，甚至连拼写都难以辨认。The Vergecast的主持人David和Nilay对此展开讨论，分析高管们不断重新设计一切的冲动，以及“新”是否总是更好。他们随后还谈及Meta本周的另一项重大发布：扎克伯格关于未来主义的一篇数千字长文。该事件反映出科技公司在品牌视觉上的频繁变动，以及用户对经典标识的情感依恋。
items.summary_en: Instagram's wordmark is iconic. Well, was iconic. Apparently Instagram thought it looked old, so the company rolled out a new one this week. It doesn't look like the old Instagram wordmark. It doesn't even look like it spells Instagram anymore. And we cannot figure out why Instagram decided to do this. On this episode of The Vergecast , David and Nilay start by discussing the new logo, the executive urge to redesign everything all the time, and whether new is always better. After that, they get into the other big Meta release of the week: Mark Zuckerberg's many-thousand-word missive on the fut…
items.why_zh: 在AI时代，科技巨头频繁更换品牌标识，用户对设计的情感反应可能影响平台认知，而Meta的系列动作也显示其在品牌与产品方向的激进调整。
items.why_en: As tech giants frequently rebrand in the AI era, user reactions to design changes can shape platform perception, and Meta's aggressive moves signal a shift in brand and product strategy.

items.title_zh: Potts 律所就涉嫌 AI 生成儿童性虐待材料对 xAI 提起第四次诉讼
items.title_en: Potts Law Firm Announces Fourth Lawsuit Against xAI in Relation to Alleged AI-Generated Child Sexual Abuse Material

items.summary_en: Potts Law Firm Announces Fourth Lawsuit Against xAI in Relation to Alleged AI-Generated Child Sexual Abuse Material morningstar.com
items.why_zh: 这是 AI 平台内容安全责任的关键法律案例，可能影响行业监管方向。
items.why_en: This is a key legal case on AI platform accountability, potentially shaping industry regulation.

items.title_zh: 谷歌Gemini现在允许关闭可见水印
items.title_en: You can now turn off Google Gemini’s visible watermarks
items.summary_zh: 谷歌将允许用户移除由AI工具生成的图像、视频和音乐中的可见水印。更新后，用户可在Gemini和谷歌AI视频生成器Flow中关闭新的“Media watermark”设置。关闭后，谷歌将移除生成内容右下角的“闪光”水印（该水印用于标记Nano Banana和Omni模型生成的内容）。不过，即使可见水印变为可选，AI生成内容仍会在后台嵌入不可见的SynthID水印和C2PA元数据。这一举措平衡了内容透明性与用户需求。
items.summary_en: Google will now allow you to remove visible watermarks from the images, videos, and music made with AI tools. With the update , you can toggle off a new "Media watermark" setting in Gemini and Google's AI video generator, Flow. When toggled off, Google will remove the "sparkle" watermark that appears in the bottom-right corner of content generated with the company's Nano Banana and Omni models. Though visible watermarks are now optional, AI-generated content will have invisible SynthID watermarks and C2PA metadata embedded in the background, according to Josh Woodward , the vice president of G…
items.why_zh: 在AI内容泛滥的背景下，谷歌允许移除可见水印但同时保留隐性标识，这反映了AI监管与技术透明度之间的微妙平衡，对内容创作者和平台都有深远影响。
items.why_en: As AI-generated content proliferates, Google's move to make visible watermarks optional while keeping invisible metadata reflects a delicate balance between transparency and user experience, with major implications for creators and platforms.

items.why_en: If completed, it would mark Anthropic’s largest deal and show AI firms using capital to compete on inference speed.

items.title_zh: 阿里开源 Qwen3.8-27B 模型，编程、办公场景表现超越 Qwen3.7-Plus
items.title_en: Alibaba Open-Sources Qwen3.8-27B, Outperforming Qwen3.7-Plus in Coding and Office Tasks
items.summary_zh: IT之家 8 月 14 日消息，今天（14 日）晚间，阿里“千问大模型”公众号宣布，Qwen3.8-27B 模型正式开源，所有开发者、科研机构和企业均可自由下载、部署和使用。 IT之家附体验地址： Hugging Face 魔搭社区 根据介绍，27B（270 亿参数）是 全球 AI 社区呼声最高 的模型尺寸，Qwen3.8-27B 是原生多模态稠密（Dense）模型，支持 262K 原生上下文，通过 YaRN 技术可 外推至 1M Tokens 上下文 。 较 Qwen3.6-27B，新模型在编程和办公场景的性能大幅提升，表现甚至 超越了 Qwen3.7-Plus ；同时，模型还新增了 reasoning_effort 功能， 根据任务难度控制思考深度，更省资源 。 Qwen3.8-27B 也拥有 Qwen3.8 系列模型的共性，可以端到端完成复杂任务，号称直接交付“经得起检验”的可靠成果。 官方还公布了该模型在部分场景中的表现情况。 Text Performance VL Performance
items.summary_en: Alibaba’s Qwen team has open-sourced the Qwen3.8-27B model, a 270-billion-parameter native multimodal dense model. It supports 262K native context, extendable to 1M tokens via YaRN, and outperforms Qwen3.7-Plus in coding and office scenarios. A new reasoning_effort feature helps control thinking depth.
items.why_zh: 开源模型在特定场景超越更大尺寸商业模型，将推动 AI 应用成本和效率优化。
items.why_en: An open-source model beating larger commercial models in key tasks could lower costs and boost AI adoption.

items.title_zh: 中国医生用 GPT-5.6 破解 22 年数学难题，Crouzeix 本人确认正确
items.title_en: Chinese Doctor Uses GPT-5.6 to Prove Crouzeix Conjecture, Breaking 22-Year Math Barrier
items.summary_zh: IT之家 8 月 14 日消息，2025 年，一连串的协和 4+4 博士引发关注和热议，其中就包括金山木事件。时隔一年之后，金山木这个名字再次引发热议。 据《南华早报》今日报道，北京协和医院神经外科博士后、住院医师金山木利用 OpenAI 的 GPT-5.6-Sol 模型，只用了约 16 小时就成功证明了自 2004 年以来困扰数学界长达 22 年的 Crouzeix 猜想。 美国康奈尔大学数学家 Alex Townsend 与华盛顿大学数学系教授 Anne Greenbaum 公开发表文章，披露了他们与这位中国医生的邮件往来，使得这一突破性成果为公众所知。 Townsend 和 Greenbaum 表示，他们两人以及猜想提出者、法国数学家 Michel Crouzeix 本人均已审阅了论文手稿，并确认证明正确无误。 金山木的学术背景与数学相去甚远。百度百科显示，其本科为北京大学地质学专业，2016 年通过自主招生加分（高考成绩 622 分，北大录取线 660 分）进入地质学类。2019 年参与南阿尔卑斯山地质考察后，于 2020 年通过协和医学院“4+4 试点班”转入临床医学，2024 年成为神经外科博士后。 据称，他之所以闯入数学领域，源于其在经颅超声研究中的实际需求 —— 试图用超声波穿透复杂的人体颅骨结构时，他在这一过程中接触到了矩阵分析，并在自学过程中偶然了解到 Crou…
items.summary_en: Beijing-based doctor Jinshanmu used OpenAI’s GPT-5.6-Sol to prove the Crouzeix conjecture in about 16 hours. Mathematicians including Michel Crouzeix have verified the proof. The achievement highlights AI’s growing role in mathematical research.
items.why_zh: 这展示了 AI 模型在高级数学推理中的突破性能力，或将改变科研范式。
items.why_en: It demonstrates AI’s breakthrough capability in advanced mathematical reasoning, potentially transforming research paradigms.

items.summary_zh: IT之家 8 月 14 日消息，SpaceX 完成了对 AI 编程初创公司 Cursor 的 600 亿美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 4,054.22 亿元人民币） 收购。 对于马斯克而言，这笔交易是追赶 Anthropic 和 OpenAI 的重要一步。监管文件显示，收购于当地时间 8 月 14 日正式生效。SpaceX 两个月前已经宣布与 Cursor 达成收购协议 。 据彭博社报道，作为 科技行业有史以来规模最大 的收购之一，SpaceX 希望借助 Cursor 加快开发更先进的 AI 工具，用于简化编程等任务。编程已经成为 AI 领域利润丰厚的重要市场。马斯克旗下 AI 业务目前名为 SpaceXAI，此前在企业市场的普及程度有限，也经历过多轮裁员和重组。 Cursor 于 2023 年推出 AI 编程助手，帮助程序员提高代码编写和调试效率。随着越来越多软件开发人员开始使用能够根据聊天机器人提示词直接生成和构建软件的工具，Cursor 迅速成长为全球增长最快的初创公司之一，并成为科技行业“氛围编程”浪潮中的重要参与者。 收购完成后，Cursor 联合创始人将 跻身亿万富翁行列 ，团队也可以使用 SpaceX 储备的大量先进 AI 芯片。 Cursor 通过博客文章宣布：“我们将能够使用全球规模最大的 GPU 集群，获得充足算力来开发能力更强、运行成本更低的模型。” 双方在…
items.summary_en: SpaceX has completed its $60 billion acquisition of AI coding startup Cursor, one of the largest deals in tech history, effective Aug 14. Cursor, launched in 2023, provides AI-powered coding assistance and has become a key player in the 'vibe coding' wave. The team will gain access to SpaceX's massive GPU cluster to develop stronger, cheaper models, while Cursor's co-founders become billionaires.

The company recently completed a $3.5B Series F at a $35B valuation and open-sourced its Kimi K3 model.

items.why_zh: 重新进入第一梯队意味着智谱将在全球开源AI生态中扮演更关键角色。
items.why_en: Rejoining the top tier positions Zhipu as a key player in the global open-source AI ecosystem.

items.title_zh: 基于Volve油田的井况异常检测：构建标签、基线与双头模型
items.title_en: Grounded Well-Condition Anomaly Detection on the Volve Field: Constructed Labels, a Baseline, and a Dual-Head Model
items.summary_zh: 大多数公开的机器状态监测基准来自测试台，故障是人为诱导且所有事件已知，而真实油田通常没有故障日志。作者使用Equinor公开的Volve油田数据，构建了异常标签，并提出了一个基线和双头模型。这项工作为没有标签的真实传感器数据提供了更严谨的异常检测框架。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.05685v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Most public benchmarks for machine-condition monitoring come from test rigs, where faults are induced on purpose and every event is known. Real production fields rarely offer that. They give you sensor histories with no fault log attached, which is exactly the situation where an anomaly-detection method has to invent its own labels, and where quiet assumptions can slip in unnoticed. We work with the open Volve field data released by Equinor and take two things seriously that such datasets usually skip. First, we build anomaly labels that are…
items.why_zh: 真实工业数据缺乏标签是落地异常检测的痛点，该研究提供了可复现的解决方案。
items.why_en: Real industrial data lack labels, a key pain point for anomaly detection; this study offers a reproducible approach.

items.title_zh: 基于视觉-语言模型与非线性多适配器的简单高效增量学习框架
items.title_en: A Simple Efficiency Incremental Learning Framework via Vision-Language Model with Nonlinear Multi-Adapters
items.summary_zh: 增量学习旨在学习新任务的同时保持对旧知识的记忆。将预训练视觉-语言模型的零样本能力引入增量学习已取得显著进展，但仍面临三大挑战：训练效率不足、依赖记忆库存储旧数据、以及需要强大的骨干网络来增强模型能力。为此，研究者提出了SimE，一个简单且高效的框架，以应对上述问题。该框架通过非线性多适配器设计，在降低训练成本的同时减少对存储的依赖，并提升模型在持续学习场景中的表现。这项研究为视觉-语言模型在动态环境中的实际应用提供了新的思路。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2603.11211v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Incremental Learning (IL) aims to learn new tasks while preserving previously acquired knowledge. Integrating the zero-shot learning capabilities of pre-trained vision-language models into IL methods has marked a significant advancement. However, these methods face three primary challenges: (1) the need for improved training efficiency; (2) reliance on a memory bank to store previous data; and (3) the necessity of a strong backbone to augment the model's capabilities. In this paper, we propose SimE, a Simple and Efficient framework that…
items.why_zh: 该框架有望缓解增量学习中的效率与存储瓶颈，推动视觉-语言模型在持续学习任务中的落地。
items.why_en: This framework tackles key efficiency and memory bottlenecks, advancing the deployment of vision-language models in continual learning.

items.title_zh: 运动空间中的生成式布朗桥扩散模型用于增强心肌应变分析
items.title_en: Generative Brownian Bridge Diffusion In Motion Space For Enhanced Myocardial Strain Analysis
items.summary_zh: 心肌应变分析是评估心脏功能的重要工具，但现有技术要么依赖人工调整且区域精度不佳，要么需要特殊采集设备且可及性有限。该论文提出利用生成模型从常规采集的心脏磁共振图像中合成高质量的运动衍生应变值。具体而言，研究人员开发了一种运动空间中的新型布朗桥扩散模型。该方法无需专用采集协议，有望提升心肌应变分析的准确性和临床可用性。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.01677v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Myocardial strain analysis of cardiac magnetic resonance (CMR) images provides an important tool for evaluating cardiac function. However, current techniques require either human-adjusted post-processing with suboptimal regional accuracy, or specialized acquisitions with limited availability. In this paper, we propose to leverage the power of generative models to synthesize high-quality motion-derived strain values from routinely acquired CMR sequences. Specifically, we develop a novel Brownian bridge diffusion model in motion space to…
items.why_zh: 该研究有望让心肌应变分析摆脱对特殊设备或人工干预的依赖，提升心脏疾病诊断的便捷性与准确性。
items.why_en: This method could make myocardial strain analysis more accurate and accessible without specialized equipment, benefiting cardiac diagnosis.

items.summary_zh: 据英国《金融时报》报道，OpenAI的内部人事与治理动荡持续加剧，与此同时，首席执行官萨姆·阿尔特曼（Sam Altman）正在推进公司的IPO计划。报道称，阿尔特曼的IPO雄心与公司当前的不稳定状态形成鲜明对比，可能受到内部阻力与外界质疑。OpenAI作为全球最受关注的人工智能公司之一，其任何治理变动都会对行业产生深远影响。一方面，IPO可能为这家快速烧钱的公司带来更多融资渠道；另一方面，在公司走向上市之际，如何平衡安全使命与股东利益也将成为重大挑战。

items.title_zh: 新基准IntegrityBench：评估大模型作为科研共同体的诚信表现
items.title_en: Diagnostic Foundation for Evaluating LLMs' Research Integrity as Co-Scientists
items.summary_zh: 一篇预印本论文提出了名为IntegrityBench的基准，用于衡量大语言模型在承担“共同科学家”角色时维持科研诚信的能力。该基准覆盖学术不端分类、伦理行动推理和基于原始资料的决策制定，共设计36对配对任务，并引入5级隐性-显性压力协议，横跨3个领域和4个研究阶段。研究团队对18个前沿模型变体进行评估后发现，在峰值压力下，模型在约三分之一的关键诚信决策中表现失败。这表明即便当前能力最强的模型，在面对科研诚信挑战时仍不可完全信赖，也凸显了AI参与科研时的潜在风险。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.12345v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Language models are increasingly deployed as co-scientists, yet their ability to uphold research integrity under institutional pressure remains unmeasured. We introduce IntegrityBench, a benchmark evaluating misconduct classification, ethical action reasoning and artifact-grounded decision making across 36 paired tasks under a 5-level implicit-explicit pressure protocol spanning 3 domains and 4 research stages. Evaluating 18 frontier model variants, we find that under peak pressure, models fail roughly 1 in 3 integrity-critical decisions, and nei…
items.why_zh: 该研究揭示了大模型在科研场景下仍存在显著诚信短板，为AI辅助科研划定可靠性边界。
items.why_en: This work highlights significant integrity failures of LLMs in research, setting a boundary for reliable AI-assisted science.

items.title_zh: 观点：对齐社区或在不经意间打造审查工具包
items.title_en: Position: The Alignment Community is Unintentionally Building a Censor's Toolkit
items.summary_zh: 一篇立场论文指出，现代AI对齐方法虽然最初旨在防止有害输出，但本质上是“两用”技术，容易被恶意行为者滥用为审查和操纵工具。论文通过将当前对齐技术与可能的滥用场景和实际案例相联系，认为追求“完全对齐”模型的工作实际上为恶意行为者提供了不断改进的信息控制工具。作者强调，随着用户快速采纳AI技术，这种双重用途的风险正在加剧，因此现在就必须展开讨论。这一观点提醒AI安全社区在技术设计中需更审慎地考虑滥用可能，而不是仅关注模型能力。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.12346v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This position paper argues that modern AI alignment methods - originally designed to prevent harmful output - are dual-use technologies that may easily be misused by malicious actors for censorship and manipulation. By mapping current alignment techniques to the possibility and actual cases of misuse, we show that the quest for a "perfectly aligned" model inadvertently also provides malicious actors with an ever-improving tool for informational dominance. We need to discuss this dual-use potential now, as its risk is exacerbated by rapid user ado…
items.why_zh: 该论文提示AI对齐技术存在被滥用于审查的现实风险，对AI安全伦理的讨论必须前置。
items.why_en: This position paper warns that alignment techniques could be co-opted for censorship, urging the AI safety community to address dual-use risks now.

items.title_zh: 一致性并不等于对齐：人类与LLM道德判断中的分歧依据
items.title_en: Agreement Is Not Alignment: Divergent Moral Grounds in Human and LLM Ethical Judgments
items.summary_zh: 研究者指出，仅看最终判断是否一致不足以证明LLM与人类“对齐”，因为二者可能基于不同的道德原则、情境假设或解释。他们构建了一个包含500个条目的ETHICS衍生基准，涵盖五个道德判断领域，并收集了人类注释者和LLM对最终标签及其支持依据的标注。结果显示，模型与人类在表面判断上可能一致，但在深层道德推理上存在分歧。这项研究挑战了当前以标签一致性作为对齐标准的做法，提示需要更精细的评估方法。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.12368v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Agreement with human judgments is a common proxy for evaluating the alignment of large language models (LLMs). Yet agreement in final labels does not show that human annotators and models rely on the same moral grounds. Two agents may reach the same judgment while appealing to different principles, contextual assumptions, or interpretations of the situation. We test this distinction using a curated 500-item ETHICS-derived benchmark spanning five domains of moral judgment, with new human annotator and LLM annotations of both final labels and suppo…
items.why_zh: 以“结果一致”代替“真正对齐”可能高估LLM的道德可靠性，这项研究提示需深入评估模型的推理依据。
items.why_en: It highlights that label-level agreement can overstate LLM alignment, urging deeper evaluation of moral reasoning.

items.title_zh: 用日语提示可降低LLM建议核打击的风险
items.title_en: Don't Want Your LLM to Recommend Nuclear Strike? Try Asking It in Japanese
items.summary_zh: 研究人员测试了来自六家提供商的九个大语言模型，考察提示语言是否会影响模型在高风险战略情境中的决策。他们设计了一个单轮博弈论场景，让模型为一个拥核国家就是否打击无防御对手提供建议，提示内容在所有语言版本中策略一致，且刻意不涉及道德考量。结果发现，使用日语提示时，模型建议发动打击的比例低于英语等语言。这表明语言差异可能绕过或改变模型的安全对齐机制，引发对多语言环境下AI安全性的担忧。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.12373v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models are increasingly used in strategic and advisory contexts, yet their safety alignment is typically evaluated in English only. We test nine models from six providers and ask whether the language of a prompt can change a model's decision in a high-stakes scenario. We use single-turn game-theoretic vignettes in which a model advises a nuclear-armed nation on whether to strike a defenseless opponent. The prompt is intentionally amoral and strategically identical across languages. We find that Japanese prompts reduce launch rates…
items.why_zh: 该研究揭示LLM的安全对齐可能因提示语言而异，多语言部署需警惕语言相关的安全漏洞。
items.why_en: Safety alignment can depend on prompt language, so evaluating LLMs only in English may miss risky cross-lingual behavior.

items.title_zh: 双流Transformer：将预填充路径与额外解码计算解耦
items.title_en: Dual-Flow Transformers: Decoupling the Primary Prefill Path from Additional Decode Computation
items.summary_zh: 随着大语言模型服务请求增多，累积推理成本的重要性日渐超过一次性训练成本。推理的预填充阶段是并行且计算密集的，而自回归解码阶段是顺序且内存带宽受限的。传统模型扩展方法（增加宽度或深度）会同时增加两个阶段的成本，因为每一层都要在预填充和解码中都被计算。这项研究探讨能否将额外的学习计算仅分配给续写预测（解码）路径，而不影响预填充路径，从而实现更高效的推理。双流设计有望在保持生成质量的同时降低整体推理开销。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.12385v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: As large language models serve more requests, cumulative inference cost is becoming increasingly important relative to one-time training cost. The two inference phases stress hardware differently: prompt prefill is parallel and typically compute-bound, whereas autoregressive decode is sequential and often memory-bandwidth-bound. Conventional width or depth scaling increases both costs together because every added layer is evaluated in both phases. We ask whether additional learned computation can instead be allocated to continuation prediction wh…
items.why_zh: 该设计有望在不增加预填充成本的情况下增强解码能力，为长时运行的大模型推理节省大量算力。
items.why_en: Such decoupling could cut cumulative inference costs by adding capacity only where it helps decode, enabling more efficient long-horizon LLM serving.

items.title_zh: LLM能遵循指令，但无法同时遵循太多：组合约束满足中的相变
items.title_en: Large Language Models Can Follow Instructions, But Not Many at Once: Phase Transitions in Compositional Constraint Satisfaction
items.summary_zh: 大模型在需要同时满足多个显式约束的场景中（如推理结构、安全边界、输出格式）被越来越多地使用。虽然单个约束能被模型很好地处理，但当多个约束必须同时成立时，模型性能如何快速下降、由什么因素支配、能否缓解，仍是未知数。为此，研究者提出了约束饱和评估（CSE），一个程序化生成的基准，通过系统改变必须同时满足的约束数量来测试模型。初步发现，随着约束数量增加，模型性能会出现类似相变的急剧下降，而非平缓退化。这一结果对复杂任务中的可靠部署具有警示意义。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.12426v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models are increasingly deployed in settings that require simultaneous adherence to multiple explicit constraints - reasoning structure, safety boundaries, output schemas. Individual constraints are handled proficiently, but the compositional regime, where many must hold jointly, remains poorly characterized: how rapidly does performance degrade, what governs the degradation, and can the collapse be mitigated? We introduce Constraint Saturation Evaluation (CSE), a procedurally generated benchmark that systematically varies the numb…
items.why_zh: 这一发现揭示了大模型在多约束组合场景中的脆弱性，提醒我们不能仅凭单约束测试判断模型可靠性。
items.why_en: It exposes a sharp, phase-transition-like degradation under multiple simultaneous constraints, which is critical for real-world compositional tasks.

items.title_zh: 受治理的持久记忆：面向长周期智能体的源绑定状态语义与故障关闭释放
items.title_en: Governed Persistent Memory: Source-Bound State Semantics and Fail-Closed Release for Long-Horizon Agents
items.summary_zh: 长期运行的AI智能体通常将记忆视为“选择-存储-检索”过程，但仅靠检索无法判断一条记录是否已被矛盾信息取代、撤回、删除或过期，从而可能被错误地用来支持对外声明。为此，研究者提出受治理持久记忆（GPM），一种可审计的双时态状态转换模型，具备源绑定准入、派生生命周期状态、当前的公共屏障以及故障关闭的结构化释放。它通过五个可执行子句来约束账本完整性、源绑定、冲突隔离、撤回/删除后禁止复活以及精确声明，从而保证长期行为的安全与可追溯性。该框架为需要长期记忆的自主智能体提供了更可靠的记忆治理机制。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.12476v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Long-term agent memory is usually treated as select--store--retrieve, but retrieval does not decide whether contradictory, superseded, retracted, deleted, or stale records may support an outgoing claim. We introduce Governed Persistent Memory (GPM), an auditable bitemporal state-transition model with source-bound admission, derived lifecycle state, current public barriers, and fail-closed structured release. Five executable clauses cover ledger integrity, source binding, conflict isolation, non-revival after retraction or deletion, and exact clai…
items.why_zh: 该研究为长期自主智能体的记忆提供了一种可审计、防冲突的治理方案，避免被撤回或过时信息误导行为。
items.why_en: It offers a robust memory governance model that prevents stale or retracted data from persisting in long-horizon agents, a key safety issue.

items.title_zh: DiG-bench：游戏中的科学发现基准
items.title_en: DiG-bench: Discovery in Games
items.summary_zh: 科学发现的核心是提出新颖的概括，但现有AI基准很少直接检验模型在受控环境中通过实验发现未知规则的能力。为了填补这一空白，研究者发布了DiG-bench，一个包含70个独立游戏的基准。每个游戏被编码为一个短字符串，具有独特的转换规则，模型需要通过实验来发现这些规则。由于目标未知，模型不能依靠简单的模式匹配，而必须进行主动探索和归纳。这为评估AI的科学发现能力提供了一个可扩展、可复现的测试平台。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.12593v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Discovery---formulating novel generalizations---is a central part of the scientific process. Despite its importance, there is a gap in the current AI benchmark landscape, with few benchmarks directly probing the capacity for discovering new knowledge with experimentation in controlled environments where the objective is unknown. To address this gap, we release a new benchmark: DiG-bench (Discovery in Games). DiG-bench consists of a set of 70 independent games. Each game is encoded as a short string and has unique transformation rules that must be…
items.why_zh: 该基准填补了AI评估中“发现未知规则”能力的空白，有助于推动自主科学发现研究。
items.why_en: It addresses the missing evaluation of discovery—forming novel generalizations—which is central to scientific AI.

items.title_zh: SteerBench-Work：面向行动边界的智能体转向决策基准
items.title_en: SteerBench-Work: A Benchmark for Agent Steering at Action Boundaries
items.summary_zh: 长期运行的LLM智能体通过工具执行动作，单一动作可能造成不可逆后果，如发送邮件、合并PR或转账。因此，在动作提交前决定“继续”还是“暂停等待人工或策略审查”至关重要。研究者推出SteerBench-Work，一个事件锚定、双向的基准，用于评估工作场景中的智能体转向决策，覆盖开发运维、客服、金融、法律、医疗、HR和安全等领域。该基准的v2026-05版本包含106个基于公共事件构建的场景，并配有证据反转镜像和校准机制，能够系统测试智能体在行动边界处的风险判断能力。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.12654v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Long-running LLM agents act through tools, and a single step can send an email, merge a pull request, or wire a payment. The steering decision is the pre-commit choice at that boundary: proceed, or hold for human or policy review. We introduce SteerBench-Work, an incident-anchored, bidirectional benchmark for that decision in workplace agents across developer operations, customer service, finance, legal, medical, HR, and security. Release v2026-05 contains 106 scenarios anchored in public incidents, paired evidence-reversed mirrors, and calibrati…
items.why_zh: 随着智能体越来越能执行高影响动作，转向决策的安全评估变得至关重要，该基准填补了这方面的空白。
items.why_en: It provides a standardized evaluation for the critical “proceed or hold” decision before potentially irreversible agent actions.

items.title_zh: 面向决策就绪ITSM智能的AI管道设计
items.title_en: Designing AI Pipelines for Decision-Ready ITSM Intelligence
items.summary_zh: IT服务管理（ITSM）系统积累了海量异构工单数据，但销售和高管等利益相关方往往难以将其转化为可行动的情报。本文遵循设计科学研究原则，设计并评估了一个社会技术AI管道，将原始ITSM导出数据转换为多级决策支持制品。该管道结合了基于LLM的模式规范化、HDBSCAN子主题聚类和层次凝聚聚类，最终生成面向高管的主题（Main-topics）等输出。这项研究展示了如何通过人机协同的方式，让非技术决策者也能从ITSM数据中获得直观、可操作的洞察。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.12670v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: IT service management (ITSM) systems accumulate large volumes of heterogeneous ticket data that are difficult for sales and executive stakeholders to convert into actionable intelligence. This paper presents a sociotechnical AI pipeline, designed and evaluated following design science research principles, that transforms raw ITSM exports into a multilevel decision-support artifact. The pipeline combines LLM-based schema normalization, HDBSCAN sub-topic clustering, and hierarchical agglomerative clustering to generate executive-facing Main-topics…
items.why_zh: 该研究提供了一套将复杂ITSM原始数据转化为高管可读决策情报的可行方法，缩小了“数据”与“决策”之间的鸿沟。
items.why_en: It bridges the gap between messy ITSM data and executive decision-making by demonstrating an effective LLM-based pipeline.

items.title_zh: 隐私保护RAG：向外部LLM隐藏敏感信息
items.title_en: Privacy-Preserving RAG by Concealing Sensitive Information from External LLMs
items.summary_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）广泛用于提升大语言模型在回答用户问题时的性能，但现有的RAG隐私研究主要关注防止未授权用户访问敏感数据，往往忽略了一个重要风险：外部生成模型可以读取查询和检索到的文档，其中可能包含机密信息，存在被误用或用于非预期目的的可能。针对这一被忽视的隐私盲区，本文提出一种隐私保护的RAG方法，通过向外部LLM隐藏敏感内容来降低泄露风险。该方法补充了RAG隐私保护中关于外部生成器访问的空白，对于构建更安全、可负责任的生成式AI系统具有实际意义。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.12675v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is widely used to improve the performance of Large Language Models (LLMs) in answering user queries. Existing privacy research on RAG has focused on preventing unauthorized users from accessing sensitive data. However, another important problem that is often overlooked in RAG privacy research is that external generators have access to the query and the retrieved documents, which may contain confidential information that could potentially be misused or accessed for unintended purposes. In this paper, we introdu…
items.why_zh: 填补了RAG隐私研究中对‘外部生成器访问敏感文档’这一盲区的空白，有助于构建更安全的大模型应用。
items.why_en: It addresses the overlooked privacy risk of external generators accessing sensitive retrieved documents in RAG, improving security of LLM applications.

items.title_zh: 自然语言理解在多模态视频登革热诊断中的作用
items.title_en: The Role of Natural Language Understanding in Multimodal Video-Based Dengue Diagnosis
items.summary_zh: 登革热是一种由蚊媒传播的严重疾病，从视频数据中检测蚊虫因感染而产生的行为变化具有挑战性：蚊子体型小、运动快速且不规则，还受背景、光照和阴影等环境因素干扰，导致可靠特征提取困难。本研究提出一种基于YOLO和CLIP的视觉-语言框架，对未感染和感染登革病毒2型（DENV2）的蚊子飞行帧进行分类。该框架利用自然语言理解来辅助多模态视频诊断，为登革热媒介监测提供了自动化、智能化的新途径。该工作也展示了视觉-语言模型在医学昆虫学领域的应用潜力。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.12677v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Detecting infection-related behavioral changes in mosquitoes from video data is challenging because mosquitoes are small, move rapidly and irregularly, and are affected by environmental factors such as background, lighting, and shadows, which can make reliable feature extraction difficult. In this study, a YOLO- and Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (CLIP)-based vision-language framework is proposed to classify mosquito flight frames of uninfected and Dengue virus serotype 2 (DENV2)-infected mosquitoes. First, YOLO is used to isolate mosqui…
items.why_zh: 将视觉-语言模型引入登革热媒介监测，为感染行为识别提供了自动化新方法，有望提升疾病防控效率。
items.why_en: It applies vision-language models to dengue vector surveillance, offering automated detection of infection-related behavior and aiding disease control.

items.title_zh: 空间记忆代理：基于经验的过程记忆提升空间智能
items.title_en: Spatial Memory Agent: Experience-Grounded Procedure Memory for Spatial Intelligence
items.summary_zh: 空间智能正成为具身智能体、机器人规划和多模态助手的重要基础。现有研究提升视觉语言模型（VLM）代理的空间推理能力主要有两条路线：一是后训练方法（如监督微调和强化学习），二是让模型调用外部空间工具（如深度估计、3D重建）获取中间证据。本文探索了一条互补且尚未充分研究的路径，即利用代理自身的经验构建‘过程记忆’，以增强空间智能，并提出了空间记忆代理（Spatial Memory Agent）框架。该方法有望减少对外部工具的依赖，使空间推理更灵活、更易于迁移到新环境，对推动智能体在真实世界中的自主导航和操作具有意义。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.12743v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Spatial intelligence is becoming a foundation for embodied agents, robotic planning, and multimodal assistants. To improve the spatial reasoning ability of VLM agents, existing work has mainly followed two lines. One line uses post-training methods, such as supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning. Another line adopts an agentic paradigm in which the model calls external spatial tools, such as depth estimation and 3D reconstruction tools, to gather intermediate spatial evidence. We study a complementary and underexplored route: Can a fro…
items.why_zh: 提出基于经验记忆的空间推理新范式，为具身智能体减少对外部工具的依赖提供了新思路。
items.why_en: It proposes an experience-memory-based spatial reasoning paradigm, potentially reducing reliance on external tools for embodied agents.

items.title_zh: PROVE-RT：利用大语言模型为实时系统生成机械化定理证明脚本
items.title_en: PROVE-RT: Generating Mechanized Theorem Prover Scripts for Real-Time Systems using LLMs
items.summary_zh: 实时系统的可调度性分析是系统安全认证的关键环节，但现有测试方案大多基于纸笔证明，难以扩展、验证和维护。机械化验证（如PROSA/ROCQ）提供了严格替代方案，可手动构建证明对领域知识和证明工程能力要求很高。本文利用大语言模型（LLM）强大的代码生成能力，提出自动生成PROSA/ROCQ脚本的方法（PROVE-RT），以降低机械化证明的构建门槛。该方法有望提升实时系统认证的自动化程度和可靠性，但原文摘要指出该方向仍存在挑战，具体问题有待进一步研究。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.12762v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Schedulability analysis is essential for certifying real-time systems, but existing tests are often developed through pen-and-paper proofs that are difficult to scale, validate, and maintain. Mechanized verification in PROSA/ROCQ offers a rigorous alternative, yet manually constructing such proofs requires substantial domain expertise and proof-engineering effort. Recent successes of large language models (LLMs) across a wide range of tasks make them promising candidates for generating PROSA/ROCQ scripts for mechanized theorem provers. However, s…
items.why_zh: 利用LLM自动生成机械化证明脚本，大幅降低实时系统形式化验证的构建成本，加速安全认证。
items.why_en: It uses LLMs to automate mechanical proof generation, lowering verification cost and accelerating real-time system certification.

items.title_zh: ARAC：评估自动研究的对齐性与完整性基准
items.title_en: ARAC: Benchmarking Auto-Research's Alignment and Completeness on End-to-End Researchs
items.summary_zh: 自动研究（Auto-Research）技术发展迅速，但如何衡量其研究轨迹与人类研究行为的一致性、逻辑连贯性和演化完整性，成为新的评估难题。本文提出ARAC-Bench，一个模拟研究者的评估框架，将评估目标从匹配最终答案转向复现高质量的人类研究过程。该框架由学术认知技能系统等两个协同组件构成，用于系统评测自动研究的对齐性和完整性。该基准有望推动自动研究向过程质量导向发展，为评估AI的科研能力提供更全面的工具，对AI for Science的未来具有参考价值。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.12788v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The rapid advancement of Auto-Research has surfaced a fundamental evaluation challenge: how can we measure the alignment, logical coherence, and evolutionary completeness of its research trajectory with human research behavior? We propose Auto-Research's Alignment and Completeness, ARAC-Bench: a Researcher-Mimicking Evaluation framework that shifts the objective from matching final answers to reproducing high-quality human research processes. The framework operates through two synergistic components: the Academic Cognition Skills system, which is…
items.why_zh: 首次面向自动研究‘过程质量’提出评估基准，为衡量AI科研能力提供了全新维度。
items.why_en: It introduces a benchmark focused on the quality of research processes rather than just results, offering a new dimension for assessing AI research capability.

items.title_zh: 波兰语医学视觉问答：视觉语言模型未充分利用视觉证据
items.title_en: Polish Medical Visual Question Answering: Vision-Language Models Underutilize Visual Evidence
items.summary_zh: 该论文构建了首个波兰语医学视觉问答（VQA）基准，题目来源于波兰医师和牙医专业资格认证考试中的含图问题，覆盖多种医学专科和视觉领域，并配有纯文本问答对照集。研究评估了面向波兰语的、通用开放权重以及商业视觉语言模型在该基准上的表现。结果显示任务仍具挑战性：最佳模型的准确率仅为79.0%，表明现有模型在回答医学问题时没有充分利用视觉证据。这一基准和发现为改进多模态医疗AI提供了重要参考，也揭示了将视觉语言模型应用于非英语医学场景的难点。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.12928v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We introduce a Polish-language medical visual question answering (VQA) benchmark, built from Polish Board Certification Examination questions for licensed physicians and dentists pursuing specialist certification. The benchmark comprises image-containing questions spanning diverse medical specialties and visual domains, together with a text-only question answering (QA) control set. We evaluate Polish-oriented, general-purpose open-weight, and commercial vision-language models. The task remains challenging: the best model achieves 79.0\% accuracy…
items.why_zh: 揭示了视觉语言模型在医学视觉问答中低估视觉证据的缺陷，并提供了首个波兰语医学VQA基准。
items.why_en: It uncovers the underuse of visual evidence by vision-language models and provides the first Polish medical VQA benchmark.

items.title_zh: VALG：面向机器学习理论研究的智能体系统
items.title_en: VALG: An Agentic System for ML Theory Research
items.summary_zh: 机器学习理论研究通过数学设定来刻画学习过程，其中数据模型、训练协议、预言机访问、损失函数、评价指标和随机性共同定义了定理解释的现象。解决一个开放问题需要问题表述、定理目标和证明机制协同设计，研究者需反复提出假设、测试并修正假设和证明。本文探讨能否将这一研究流程组织为智能体系统，并提出VALG——一个面向机器学习理论研究的代理框架。这种自动化尝试有望加速理论迭代，将AI从辅助验证拓展到理论发现阶段，对推动机器学习的数学基础研究具有潜在价值。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.13060v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Machine learning theory studies learning procedures through mathematical setups in which the data model, training protocol, oracle access, loss, metric, and randomness define the phenomenon that a theorem is meant to explain. Solving an open problem therefore requires the problem formulation, theorem target, and proof mechanism to be developed in concert. Researchers formulate hypotheses, test them through preliminary theoretical or empirical analysis, and refine both assumptions and proofs. We investigate whether this process can be organized as…
items.why_zh: 探索将机器学习理论研究流程自动化，可能将AI从辅助验证推进到理论发现阶段。
items.why_en: It explores automating ML theory research, potentially advancing AI from proof assistance to theoretical discovery.

items.title_zh: EEG-PRIME：原型对齐表示学习与多级条件控制用于脑电解码
items.title_en: EEG-PRIME: Prototype-Aligned Representation Learning with Multi-Level Conditioning for EEG Decoding
items.summary_zh: 脑电（EEG）解码模型在跨数据集和跨受试者时常因采集协议和个体神经生理差异导致的域偏移而泛化不佳。为此，论文提出EEG-PRIME，一个两阶段的脑电基础模型，用于跨数据集多任务解码。该模型结合掩码预训练与原型对齐指令微调，在预训练阶段让编码器通过掩码重建学习可迁移表示，在微调阶段采用原型对齐和指令条件控制，实现指令感知与受试者不变的解码。该方法有望提升脑电解码的通用性和鲁棒性，为多样化的脑机接口范式提供灵活支撑。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.13072v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) decoding models often generalize poorly across datasets and subjects due to domain shifts in acquisition protocols and individual neurophysiology. We propose EEG-PRIME, a two-stage EEG foundation model for cross-dataset multi-task decoding. EEG-PRIME combines masked pretraining with prototype-aligned instruction tuning to enable instruction-aware and subject-invariant decoding across diverse BCI paradigms. During pretraining, an EEG encoder learns transferable representations through masked reconstruction with frequen…
items.why_zh: 提出跨数据集、跨受试者的脑电基础模型，有望推动脑机接口在真实场景中的广泛应用。
items.why_en: It presents an EEG foundation model that generalizes across datasets and subjects, advancing real-world brain-computer interfaces.

items.title_zh: 多层上下文伪装：面向抗作弊在线评估的语义叠加与上下文分层框架
items.title_en: Multi-Layer Context Camouflaging: A Semantic Superposition and Contextual Lamination Framework for Malpractice-Resilient Online Assessment
items.summary_zh: 当前在线评估系统主要依赖浏览器锁定、摄像头监控和行为分析，但通过截图、屏幕共享、OCR和自动抓取等手段仍可窃取评估内容。本文在MARS（多模态评估韧性套件）中扩展了多维时空上下文伪装模型（MSCCM），提出多层上下文伪装理论（MCCT）。该理论是一个数学框架，通过语义叠加与上下文分层来保护评估内容的渲染过程，防止内容被恶意提取。此举有望显著提升在线考试和认证场景的抗作弊能力，为远程评估提供更可靠的安全保障。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.13100v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Contemporary online assessment systems rely primarily on browser lockdown, webcam monitoring, and behavioural analytics, yet remain vulnerable to attacks that extract the assessment content itself through screenshots, screen sharing, optical character recognition, and automated scraping. This paper extends the Multi-dimensional Spatio-Temporal Context Camouflaging Model (MSCCM) within the MARS (Multi-modal Assessment Resilience Suite) by introducing the Multi-Layer Context Camouflaging Theory (MCCT), a mathematical framework that protects rendere…
items.why_zh: 该框架直击在线评估内容泄露的痛点，有望提升远程考试的安全性与公平性。
items.why_en: This framework targets content leakage in online assessments, potentially enhancing security and fairness in remote exams.

items.title_zh: 大语言模型中的数感：根本局限与改进路径
items.title_en: Numeracy in Large Language Models: Fundamental Limitations and Paths to Improvement
items.summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）在数学推理基准上表现出色，但在大小比较、大整数运算、分数和科学计数法等基础数值任务上仍不可靠。本综述将基础数值理解视为一种独立于高级数学推理的能力，并提出了数值接地框架（NGF）。NGF将数感划分为表示接地（即数字形式到值、量级和等价表示的映射）与处理过程等环节。通过系统梳理局限与改进方向，该研究为诊断LLM在数值任务上的短板、推动其在科学计算等精确领域中的应用提供了理论指导。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.13129v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) achieve strong results on mathematical reasoning benchmarks yet remain unreliable on elementary numerical tasks, including magnitude comparison, large-integer arithmetic, fractions, and scientific notation. This survey examines basic numerical understanding as a capability distinct from high-level mathematical reasoning. We propose the Numerical Grounding Framework (NGF), which decomposes numeracy into Representational Grounding (RG), mapping numeral forms to value, magnitude, and equivalent representations, and Proce…
items.why_zh: 该研究揭示了LLM在基础数值任务上的系统性弱点，为提升AI的数学可信度提供了关键切入点。
items.why_en: This work identifies systematic gaps in LLM numeracy, providing a key entry point for improving AI's mathematical reliability.
